observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large indoor hall with a wooden parquet floor, possibly a school gymnasium or community hall, set up for a social gathering or dance event with seated spectators and tables along the sides.
observation.dancers: A group of young adults and teenagers in mixed couples (men and women).
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers start in sets of multiple couples (four couples per set) arranged in squares or circles, then circle around and pair up to travel around the room in a larger ring or pairs.
observation.posture: Upright torso, upright posture with knees relatively straight and weight shifting between feet.
observation.footwork: Walking and stepping in time with the music; precise steps cannot be fully determined due to low frame rate and wide angle.
observation.arms_and_hands: Partners holding hands in a circle or facing each other, sometimes joining hands overhead in arches or resting on hips.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright and still, with natural sway during travel steps.
observation.partnering: Couples hold hands or frame each other, transitioning between circle formations and paired ballroom holds.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level throughout, small turns and spinning transitions in pairs, no jumps or floor work visible.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear white long-sleeved shirts, black trousers, and bow ties; women wear black tops and dark flared skirts with white polka dots and red belts.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight transfer, foot placement detail, and rapid step variations cannot be seen due to camera distance and video resolution.

signature_moments.what: Dancers join hands in a circle and step sideways together moving in a coordinated ring rotation.
Couples link arms and spin together in pairs across the floor.
